Endometriosis is a chronic, painful condition often misdiagnosed for years. The NHS is now funding two new tests: a saliva-based microRNA analysis and an electrical gut-signal sensor, both designed to provide definitive, non-invasive results.

Patients who spent years doubting their own sanity are finally receiving the validation and medical support they deserve, shifting the power dynamic from patient-as-complainer to patient-as-partner.
